capabilities: Preview external URLs in a floating window via modifier-click or a command
Open previews in a reusable right-side panel beside the note
Navigate previewed pages with back/forward, an address bar, and per-domain zoom
Convert bare URLs and GitHub references to Markdown links with page titles
Show GitHub hover cards for issues and pull requests
extras: Exposes a JavaScript API so other plugins can open previews or show notes in the side panel. On mobile, or where the embedded browser is unavailable, it falls back to an iframe, so sites that block framing show a blank page and in-page back/forward does not work.
problem: Obsidian opens external links in the default browser, forcing users to leave the app just to glance at a linked page.

relations.evidence: a folder opens a list of its docs (Arc Theme's breadcrumb dropdown when Arc is on)

summary: In-app URL previewer that opens external links in a floating embedded browser window or a reusable side panel on modifier-click.
